TMC rally in Kolkata sees clashes, accusations between party and BJP

A Trinamool Congress rally in Kolkata, led by Mamata Banerjee, was disrupted by clashes between TMC and BJP workers. Eggs were allegedly thrown, and slogans like 'Chor, Chor' were chanted. Mamata Banerjee accused the BJP and the police of obstructing the rally, which she claimed had High Court permission. Rebel TMC factions and internal party matters were also highlighted in some reports.
